settings.text:
Get the most out of your old breathalysers

We offer trade in deals for both personal and workplace breathalyser units. Check out the options below.

settings.heading: Trade-in to an Andatech workplace breathalyser

settings.text: Trade in your old breathalysers of any brand for a brand new Andatech Prodigy S, Surety, or Soberlive FRX through Andatech's breathalyser trade-in bundles.

settings.heading: Andatech Surety bundle
settings.text:
Trade in personal breathalysers from AlcoSense or any brand and receive

  • Andatech Surety worth $649
  • Mouthpieces x100 worth $65
  • Sampling cups x10 worth $50
  • Online training worth $139

settings.heading: Andatech Prodigy S bundle
settings.text:
Trade in industrial breathalysers from Andatech or any brand and receive

  • Andatech Prodigy S worth $690
  • Mouthpieces x100 worth $65
  • Sampling cups x10 worth $22
  • Online training worth $139

settings.heading: Andatech Soberlive FRX bundle
settings.text:
Trade in wall mounted breathalysers from Andatech or any brand and receive

  • Andatech Soberlive FRX
  • Straws x1,000
  • Sampling cups x10
  • Andalink plan
Submit the form to receive a quote on the bundles that you are interested in.
Receive the return shipping label for sending us your breathalysers after making payment.
Pack and drop off your breathalysers at Aus Post. Once inspected, we will send you your brand new Andatech breathalysers.

settings.heading: My old breathalysers do not work sometimes. Can I trade them in?
settings.text: Trade-in breathalysers can be of any age and working condition. However, they should be in acceptable physical condition with no major damage or missing built-in parts or components.

settings.heading: What brands are accepted for the trade-in deal?
settings.text: We accept breathalysers of any brand for our trade-in deal.

settings.heading: Are the original box, manual or accessories required?
settings.text: The original box, manual or accessories are not required.

settings.heading: Is the bundle price inclusive of shipping fees?
settings.text: Bundle prices exclude shipping fees and GST.
